worldcombat.skill.highhorsepower.summary: Lower the whole body and slam with raw mass in a flat charge: on contact, the horsepower figure read from weight and speed floats above the impact, and the dust thrown up follows that same number. The user plants and stops afterwards, leaving no crater and paying no self-cost - the mass is the whole move.
worldcombat.skill.highhorsepower.descrip: The whole body deals %1$s contact damage and shoves the target %2$s blocks along the charge.
Charge %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick, with a %3$s block trample radius.
worldcombat.skill.highhorsepower.press.o: Body-press form: higher power and a heavy down-pressed dust ring that keeps the target close; at the cost of a shorter shove, a shorter charge and a longer cooldown.
Head-on form: a longer shove, a longer charge and a shorter cooldown; at slightly lower power.
worldcombat.skill.highhorsepower.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
From level %1$s the charge rises to %2$s and the run to %3$s blocks.
From level %1$s the charge rises to %2$s and the shove to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.highhorsepower.use.0: Charge one target low with your entire mass
worldcombat.skill.highhorsepower.use.1: Drive the foe off its ground, or pin it close
worldcombat.skill.highhorsepower.use.2: Turn weight and speed into a visible horsepower figure
worldcombat.skill.highhorsepower.prefere: On: 108% power and a heavy down-pressed dust ring, at 60% shove, 90% charge and +6 cooldown - pin the foe close. Off (head-on): 125% shove, 110% charge and -4 cooldown, at 95% power - drive the target off its ground.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of charging. Larger values chase harder.
On: charge the nearest body instead of running past it to a farther target. Off: rank it as an ordinary mid-range contact strike.
